lines.t: Use: Constructs a mana well that allows you and others sitting nearby to regenerate [(60 < 24 ? 10 : (60 < 34 ? 15 : (60 < 44 ? 20 : (60 < 54 ? 24 : 29))))] Mana every 5 sec, mutually exclusive with Blessing of Wisdom.
Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
Use: Places a fermenter that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all of the benefits of a Mana Well. Requires a Campfire nearby.
May be placed over a Mana Well to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
Use: Places an Alchemy Laboratory usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Mana Well. Requires a Campfire nearby.
